title: Best. Food tour. Ever.
text: Our Culinary Backstreets Barcelona tour of Sants could not have been better. Our tour guide, Guillaume, made this the single best experience we had in our entire time in Spain. The tour was about 5 -5.5 hours long, as promised, and so much more than we hoped for. Guillaume was warm, incredibly knowledgeable, kind, and helpful. The spots we visited were truly unique, family owned & run businesses with history and significance in a very un-touristy area of the city. title: A great day out in a different area of Barcelona!
text: We spent the day with Sanem, our very personable and knowledgeable guide. We know Barcelona well, so to venture to a new area and learn about the culture and food made for a completely enjoyable day. The food and locations we visited we never would have found on our own. Sanem really took the time and effort to answer our questions and ensure we had a great time!
author: 6KP6

title: Unforgettable experience
text: Guillaume was an excellent guide and we had an incredible experience at every stop! We could have never known about or navigated the places he took us to on our own without knowing the area and the language. We had some truly delicious bites that we're working to recreate at home. We also learned a ton!
author: Katie553

title: Pam is fantastic
text: Pam was excellent!  She has a wealth of knowledge, great personality and very professional.  Strongly recommend her.
author: P1583GJtonia

title: Had a great time and will not hesitate to recommend others to join this tour.
text: Our guide Pam was fantastic. She was very thorough and patient in explaining to us all the history about the local area and seamless incorporating the food we ate along the way on how they relate to the local environment. She knows each establishment very well hence was able to recommend what is the specialty of each places we stop to eat. The tour exceeded our expectation and we will have not hesitate to sign up for another tour in another city we visit in the future. Thanks again, we had a wonderful time tasting the food and learning about the local community.
author: Cuti08

title: Pam provided an incredible introduction to Sants culture
text: Whenever we travel, we always check to see if Culinary Backstreets is there.   We have taken many tours, including Istanbul and other unique cities.   It NEVER fails to deliver. Our tour with Pam was no exception.   What we find different about CB is that the guides are extremely knowledgeable, and they have done their homework about the culinary culture of the area.  The guides know the proprietors, and the shops are expecting and welcoming us.  We had just taken 2 tours with another company in Morocco, and the situation seemed unplanned and ad hoc. title: Best food tour for local experience
text: Guillermo was amazing! This was the best tour. We wanted to have a very local, homey tour that really represented the cultural roots of the area. This even exceeded that- we were able to go to super local and family owned places and taste food made with love for generations. Guillermo was so informed and taught me everything I wanted to learn about Catalan culture and cuisine.
author: Z3593ZCbryceb

title: A tastebud sensation in Sants
text: This was a sensational way to get under the skin of this fabulous city. Pam was a knowledgable warm guide with a clear passion for food drink and Barcelona. I would recommend the Sants tour unequivocally.
